svg.aria-label: Interactive three-phase commit protocol with one coordinator and five participants. Each node can be toggled online or offline at any point in a transaction; failures mid-transaction play out the protocol's real behavior — quorum aborts, timeout aborts while uncertain, and recovery commits once PRE-COMMIT is out — instead of restarting. A restore-all control sits in the header next to the transaction number.

g.aria-label: COORDINATOR is online. Activate to turn it off.
PARTICIPANT 1 is online. Activate to turn it off.
PARTICIPANT 2 is online. Activate to turn it off.
PARTICIPANT 3 is offline. Activate to turn it on.
PARTICIPANT 4 is online. Activate to turn it off.
PARTICIPANT 5 is online. Activate to turn it off.
